verdict.rationale: React's own repository states the story nearly word for word: 'Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them to make complex UIs' (react-gh-1). The docs back this up: components carry their own logic and appearance (react-docs-11), React re-renders when components receive new data from interactions (react-docs-3, react-docs-24), and DevTools can inspect and edit component state (react-docs-14). Missing for 10: no in-depth first-party reference in the pack on the local-state mechanism itself (e.g. state hooks), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of component encapsulation and composition.
